name: Nonohara Utai
source:
A girl who sit beside the protagonist in the class. At the very glance looks like a stands out girl, but is actually a gentle and full of consideration for others. Has a bit of little devil personality and often tease the protagonist. 

For the protagonist, she's his first friend. As well as first love.
